one-edge-failure.notes: Requires authorized provider-LB and node access; do not infer from DNS or a single curl.

one-control-plane-failure.notes: Requires an approved control-plane failure drill and must preserve etcd quorum.

limitations: No provider VIP has been provisioned in this repository-only change.
No production firewall, DNS, TLS SAN, kubeconfig, or backend state was changed.
No failure or recovery measurement is valid until an authorized operator records raw timestamps and redacted probe results.
